purpose: Pre-ledger proposed Todo catalog; no Todo authority mutation.

interfaces.name: Namespace-qualified persistent identity
interfaces.semantics: Explicit producer namespace plus local 64-bit identity; adapters preserve legacy IDs without hashing pointers or conflating content identity.

interfaces.name: Exact logical coverage and role
interfaces.semantics: Typed axes, structure/epoch, exact member or edge set, role, canonical maps, global 64-bit identity, compact local indexes; proposal/halo/replica/contribution roles are distinct.

interfaces.name: Atom requirement descriptor
interfaces.semantics: Coverage, planes, order, numeric/index types, extent and alignment rules, generation, target, graph-stability, and accepted transform routes.

interfaces.name: Atom affordance descriptor
consumers: CellShard atom store, graph compiler, persistence planner
interfaces.semantics: What a physical or output atom can directly satisfy, including operation families, planes, orders, partial forms, target ABI, direct gradient/output, and persistence eligibility.

interfaces.name: Partial-result algebra
consumers: CellShard global graph, partial persistence, collection
interfaces.semantics: State schema, neutral element, merge, finalize, algebraic laws, order/determinism constraints, numeric policy, and stable implementation identities.

interfaces.name: Operation decomposition alternatives
interfaces.semantics: Legal split axes, exact input/output/partial coverage, replication and halos, order constraints, partial algebra, numeric consequences, and complete unsplit fallback.

interfaces.name: Atom-fragment request and candidate frontier
interfaces.semantics: Atom-bound operation request plus bounded Pareto alternatives, exact cover, requirements/affordances, program recipe, resources, local complete cost, and verifier receipt.

interfaces.name: Multi-extent external binding
interfaces.semantics: Ordered extents with address space, offsets, alignment, order, generation, readiness and lease tokens; raw runtime handles are not durable.

interfaces.name: Lowering-resumption contract
interfaces.semantics: Canonical, evidence, semantic atom/basis, target cover, projection, packed operand, executable recipe, topology-linked and resident stages with validation, fallback and phases-bypassed.

interfaces.name: External global cost vector
interfaces.semantics: Generic storage, build, memory, movement, canonicalization, combine, replication, invalidation, latency and throughput prices; never overrides correctness.

interfaces.name: Atom-aware execution export v2
interfaces.semantics: Exact coverage, decomposition, requirements/affordances, partial algebra, persistent orders, stage graph, candidate frontier, complete local cost, compatibility and freshness.

interfaces.name: Common atom envelope
interfaces.semantics: Level-relative atom identity, species, exact coverage, typed ports, planes, dependencies, evidence, affordances and lineage; candidate/certified/basis/physical/replica/partial/super/resident states remain distinct.

interfaces.name: Atom evidence atlas
interfaces.semantics: Overlapping approximate proposal evidence, provenance, strata, confidence/stability, negative evidence and exact-rescan status; never execution ownership.

interfaces.name: Composition production and derivation
interfaces.semantics: Typed inputs/output, parameters, exact coverage equation, identity/order/generation rules, contribution semantics, cost, invalidation, verifier and multi-parent derivation DAG.

interfaces.name: Biological execution basis manifest
interfaces.semantics: Selected atoms/productions for workload-family distribution, budgets, objective vector, memberships, no-basis fallback, dependencies, validity and cost freshness.

interfaces.name: Persistent partial atom
interfaces.semantics: Exact dependency closure, contribution coverage, merge/finalize algebra, numeric policy, generation, persistence legality and profitability.

interfaces.name: Atom-store generation and physical instance
interfaces.semantics: Immutable root, atom dictionary, indexes, grammar/bases/partials, actions/lineage, large arenas and frames, encoded replicas, atomic publication, recovery, consolidation and GC.

interfaces.name: Global operation provider and portable schedule
interfaces.semantics: Provider-neutral typed operations/effects, atom flow, graph families, rewrites, local fragment alternatives, partial trees, replay modes and machine-independent schedule.

interfaces.name: Exact distributed certificate
interfaces.semantics: Exact inputs, owners, contributors, halos, replicas, partial algebra/tree, generations, effects, canonical recovery and duplicate/omission proof.

interfaces.name: Topology realization, transport and residency lease
interfaces.semantics: Topology-linked placement, sources, routes, resident atom planes, ready events, lease/pin lifetime, reconstruction, runtime command graph and no durable raw handles.

barriers.reason: Freeze exact source and authority without mutating prior campaigns.
Identity, coverage, atom envelope, planes, requirements, affordances and partial algebra are stable enough for parallel providers.
Approximate proposals and exact certification are operationally separate.
CellShard can request exact atom-bound local alternatives without inventing Cellerator semantics.
Atoms have real typed composition and a complete no-basis fallback.
Persistent products and lowering stages are exact, versioned and recoverable.
Portable schedule, exact distributed certificate, topology, transport, residency and command runtime are available.
Independent vertical slices prove the atom hierarchy reaches real Cellerator execution and distributed runtime.

promotion_gates.question: Flat explicit composition DAG versus induced execution grammar
promotion_gates.metrics: induction/matching time, grammar bytes, assembly avoided, transforms, I/O, end-to-end graph-family cost
promotion_gates.promote: Exact derivations and positive amortized complete-cost benefit over the flat DAG across the declared reuse horizon.
promotion_gates.fallback: Retain explicit grammar and flat basis; store negative grammar evidence.

promotion_gates.question: One global basis versus multiple workload-family bases
promotion_gates.metrics: storage amplification, graph coverage, assembly, reuse, mutation/invalidation, complete cost
promotion_gates.promote: Portfolio is nondominated and amortized savings exceed additional storage/build/maintenance.
promotion_gates.fallback: Single basis or no-basis per workload family.

promotion_gates.question: Disjoint versus bounded overlapping atoms/bases
promotion_gates.metrics: occupancy/reuse, duplicated bytes, input replication, gradient reconciliation, storage, exact ownership
promotion_gates.promote: Complete cost improves with certified unique contribution ownership and bounded duplication.
promotion_gates.fallback: Zero-overlap path, which must be equivalent to disjoint baseline.

promotion_gates.question: Seed-expand versus spectral co-clustering
promotion_gates.metrics: search memory/time, candidate quality, exact useful support, residual, downstream complete cost
promotion_gates.promote: Better certified atom utility after search amortization on more than planted fixtures.

promotion_gates.question: Bounded typed motifs versus frequent-fragment mining
promotion_gates.metrics: search complexity, exact recurrence, reusable execution benefit, null false positives
promotion_gates.promote: Discovers profitable atoms missed by templates within explicit budgets.
promotion_gates.fallback: Bounded motif library or no motif atoms.

promotion_gates.question: No factor/topic atoms versus factor-derived proposals
promotion_gates.metrics: exact candidate utility, storage, overlap, cross-operation reuse, null comparison
promotion_gates.promote: Adds nondominated certified atoms beyond existing providers.
promotion_gates.fallback: Retain factor evidence as nonselected proposals.

promotion_gates.question: Ordinary trajectory window caching versus prefix/delta materialization
promotion_gates.metrics: delta bytes, prefix reuse, random access, reconstruction, invalidation, total graph cost
promotion_gates.promote: Positive amortized benefit on real/planted trajectory families and collapse under trajectory-null disruption.

promotion_gates.question: Explicit contiguous assembly versus direct multi-extent Cellerator execution
promotion_gates.metrics: assembly bytes/time, kernel efficiency, TLB/cache, launches, memory, reuse break-even
promotion_gates.promote: Complete cost wins in a defined extent/operation region with no hidden full assembly.

promotion_gates.question: Per-operation projections versus generalized cross-operation view families
promotion_gates.metrics: local kernel loss, storage, preparation, transforms, canonicalization, cross-operation reuse
promotion_gates.promote: Global graph-family cost wins for a declared operation mixture.
promotion_gates.fallback: Keep shared semantic support identity with specialized physical views.

promotion_gates.question: One-pass external costs versus bounded exchange/column generation
promotion_gates.metrics: compile time, candidates added, objective improvement, prediction error, stability
promotion_gates.promote: Material global improvement beyond one-pass under strict budget and reproducible calibration.

promotion_gates.question: Synchronous exact reads versus asynchronous multi-range I/O
promotion_gates.metrics: /mnt/block throughput, latency, CPU, queue memory, range count, read amplification
promotion_gates.promote: Improves complete atom delivery without excessive memory or instability.
promotion_gates.fallback: Synchronous exact reads and explicit prefetch.

promotion_gates.question: Size/LRU-like residency versus reconstruction-aware residency
promotion_gates.metrics: hit rate, rematerialization, stalls, memory, eviction regret, complete graph cost
promotion_gates.promote: Reduces total reconstruction/I/O/compute under stable traces without pathological starvation.

promotion_gates.question: Raw/index baseline versus CPU/GPU atom-aware compression
promotion_gates.metrics: stored/read bytes, decode, scratch, H2D, direct consumption, total latency
promotion_gates.promote: I/O-to-kernel complete cost wins for a specific object species/storage tier.
promotion_gates.fallback: Per-object raw or simple index encoding.

promotion_gates.question: One process versus per-NUMA-node or per-GPU runtime
promotion_gates.metrics: control overhead, NUMA locality, NCCL/CUDA Graph behavior, failures, memory, throughput
promotion_gates.promote: Select per deployment profile; no one process model enters portable schedule identity.

promotion_gates.question: Relearned atom evidence versus cross-dataset template warm start
promotion_gates.metrics: compile time, candidate recall, exact acceptance, false reuse, end-to-end benefit
promotion_gates.promote: Warm start reduces compile cost without reducing exact quality and is revalidated on target data.

promotion_gates.question: Demand/sequential prefetch versus trajectory-predictive prefetch
promotion_gates.metrics: hit rate, wrong-prefetch bytes, memory, stalls, transition uncertainty
promotion_gates.promote: Positive complete-cost benefit under supplied trajectory probabilities and valid null behavior.

promotion_gates.question: CPU atom linker versus GPU-assisted linking
promotion_gates.metrics: link time, host bytes, GPU occupancy, contention, downstream residency and graph cost
promotion_gates.promote: Wins when result remains GPU-resident without displacing more valuable compute.

promotion_gates.question: No superatom versus promoted superatom
promotion_gates.metrics: assembly avoided, direct execution, storage rent, invalidation, graph-family reuse
promotion_gates.promote: Positive amortized complete benefit with retained parent lineage.

CEBOOT.title: Cellerator baseline, charter, and source ownership
CEBOOT.biological_motivation: A source-backed charter prevents later agents from reducing the integrated compiler to generic distribution and preserves the biological-performance thesis already embodied in Cellerator.
CEBOOT.architectural_reason: This work freezes only the current baseline, ownership, and compatibility map. It creates the stable context from which all implementation lanes can proceed without reinterpreting legacy boundaries.
CEBOOT.algorithm: Record both Git and Todo cursors separately; Project Control observations are not globally atomic. Classify each live subsystem as preserve, adjacent extension, generalize, compatibility-only, migrate, or retire-after-gate.

CEFRAG.title: Atom-aware Cellerator fragment compiler
CEFRAG.biological_motivation: A reusable CellShard atom is only useful if Cellerator can compile the exact biological coverage, order, mutable planes, and partial output that atom represents.
CEFRAG.architectural_reason: The fragment compiler is the primary local lowering boundary. It wraps rather than replaces program_v2, validates externally proposed structure, and emits a bounded Pareto frontier rather than a single locally optimal answer.
CEFRAG.algorithm: Use a two-pass requirements/query API. Adapt operation_core_v2 into an atom-fragment request, build compact local index spaces, validate the external cover and order, discover local candidates, retain nondominated alternatives, and prepare the chosen program_v2 inside a prepared_atom_fragment wrapper. No hidden allocation occurs after requirements are returned.

tasks.title: Register and independently validate decomposition providers
tasks.workstream_title: Biological operation decomposition and partial algebra
tasks.purpose: Register and independently validate decomposition providers. Deliver this as one isolated, reviewable step in the Biological operation decomposition and partial algebra workstream.
tasks.biological_motivation: Biological relations permit meaningful split dimensions—destination programs, source regulators, support edges, segments, relation types, and trajectories—that a generic scheduler cannot infer safely.
tasks.compiler_architectural_reason: CellShard may choose global decomposition only from alternatives whose mathematical legality and partial-result reconstruction are declared by Cellerator or another operation provider.
explicit_out_of_scope: Do not add distributed placement or topology policy to Cellerator.
Do not infer associative or commutative semantics from a kernel name or destination_update flag.
Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.
Do not encode V100 tile dimensions, GPU ordinals, topology routes, or runtime pointers in portable biological identity.
Do not mutate frozen CSG1, CPE2, CPK1, CSPACK, or CSH5 wire semantics without an adjacent version and compatibility route.
Do not move Cellerator mathematical semantics into CellShard or CellShard global placement/storage semantics into standalone Cellerator.
expected_inputs: The frozen shared atom/coverage/identity contracts applicable to this workstream.
Exact live source identities revalidated before implementation.
Caller-owned capacities, cost/reuse policy, and biological-stratum metadata where relevant.
expected_outputs: Focused tests and adversarial fixtures demonstrating both success and explicit rejection paths.
tasks.mechanism:
Assemble source-linked provider fragments; validate stable IDs, exact coverages, partial algebras, operation compatibility, and complete unsplit fallback. Avoid a central type switch.

Workstream mechanism: Represent each decomposition as a data-only alternative naming split axis, exact input coverage, output or partial coverage, replication/halo requirements, persistent-order constraints, partial algebra, numerical/determinism consequences, and candidate family. Every operation keeps a complete unsplit fallback.
data_flow_and_ownership: Cold builders may own explicit temporary storage; public execution views remain non-owning pointer-plus-count records.
Semantic identity and exact coverage are inputs or validated outputs; storage location and runtime pointers remain operational state.
Central registries, umbrella headers, package exports, and root CMake are changed only by the designated integration task.
complexity_expectations: Document asymptotic and peak-memory behavior.
Reject unbounded all-pairs or unrestricted subgraph enumeration unless this Todo is an exact small-instance oracle.
Use streaming, bounded top-L structures, sketches, sparse maps, count/scan/fill, radix/sort, or caller-owned marks as appropriate.
tasks.cold_vs_hot_path: The named mechanism is cold compilation unless explicitly described as runtime. Any steady-state path must perform no discovery, catalog parsing, hidden allocation, global sorting, or topology search.
invariants: Canonical biological identity is explicit and recoverable; shape, ordinal position, or equal extent never establishes equivalence.
Approximate evidence may propose work, but only independently certified exact coverage may enter execution.
Proposal overlap, physical-representation overlap, and execution-contribution overlap remain distinct.
Each logical contribution has one exact owner unless a versioned partial-result algebra proves reconstruction.
Structure, mutable values, transient state, runtime residency, and preference/cost freshness have separate generations and invalidation.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not add distributed placement or topology policy to Cellerator.
Do not infer associative or commutative semantics from a kernel name or destination_update flag.
Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.
Do not encode V100 tile dimensions, GPU ordinals, topology routes, or runtime pointers in portable biological identity.
Do not mutate frozen CSG1, CPE2, CPK1, CSPACK, or CSH5 wire semantics without an adjacent version and compatibility route.
Do not move Cellerator mathematical semantics into CellShard or CellShard global placement/storage semantics into standalone Cellerator.
failure_cases_and_fallback: Malformed or stale identity/generation data must be rejected before execution.
Weak or unstable biological structure must produce a valid no-candidate or no-promotion outcome.
Capacity overflow, duplicate identity, incomplete coverage, and candidate explosion must return explicit diagnostics.
validation: For every split, reconstruct the unsplit CPU/GPU reference and test empty, singleton, tail, duplicate, and nonfinite cases.
Add deterministic unit tests, malformed-input tests, and randomized property tests.
Where an approximate proposal is used, compare it with an exact rescan and independently validate the certified output.
Keep at least one canonical/reference fallback and differential-test against it.
performance_evidence: Record cold build time, peak memory, candidate count, and work avoided or added.
Do not promote from microkernel speed alone; report complete cost and reuse break-even.
A measured non-promotion is an acceptable terminal result for experimental mechanisms.

tasks.compiler_architectural_reason: The compiler must compare explicit assembly with direct multi-extent execution rather than forcing every atom portfolio into a monolithic matrix.
explicit_out_of_scope: Do not make scatter-gather mandatory for kernels that require contiguous storage.
Do not allow pointer arrays to substitute for exact atom identity or coverage.
Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.
Do not encode V100 tile dimensions, GPU ordinals, topology routes, or runtime pointers in portable biological identity.
Do not mutate frozen CSG1, CPE2, CPK1, CSPACK, or CSH5 wire semantics without an adjacent version and compatibility route.
Do not move Cellerator mathematical semantics into CellShard or CellShard global placement/storage semantics into standalone Cellerator.
expected_inputs: The frozen shared atom/coverage/identity contracts applicable to this workstream.
Exact live source identities revalidated before implementation.
Caller-owned capacities, cost/reuse policy, and biological-stratum metadata where relevant.
expected_outputs: A machine-readable evidence record containing the baseline, candidate, complete-cost metrics, environment identity, and promotion disposition.
tasks.mechanism:
Measure preparation bytes, pointer/descriptor overhead, kernel efficiency, cache/TLB behavior, launches, memory, and reuse break-even; promote only complete-cost wins.

Workstream mechanism: Define lists of atom ports and extents, query contiguity/alignment/index requirements, compile an explicit gather/scatter assembly baseline, and add direct multi-extent candidates behind measurement gates. A candidate claiming direct execution may not perform full hidden assembly.
data_flow_and_ownership: Cold builders may own explicit temporary storage; public execution views remain non-owning pointer-plus-count records.
Semantic identity and exact coverage are inputs or validated outputs; storage location and runtime pointers remain operational state.
Central registries, umbrella headers, package exports, and root CMake are changed only by the designated integration task.
complexity_expectations: Document asymptotic and peak-memory behavior.
Reject unbounded all-pairs or unrestricted subgraph enumeration unless this Todo is an exact small-instance oracle.
Use streaming, bounded top-L structures, sketches, sparse maps, count/scan/fill, radix/sort, or caller-owned marks as appropriate.

invariants: Canonical biological identity is explicit and recoverable; shape, ordinal position, or equal extent never establishes equivalence.

tasks.biological_motivation: Approximate biological discovery is useful only if exact canonical identity, coverage, halos, replicas, contributions, and partial reconstruction are certified independently.
tasks.compiler_architectural_reason: Certification is a separate authority from every proposal provider and must scale to relations larger than one kernel-local index range.
explicit_out_of_scope: Discovery providers may not self-certify by setting a flag.
Do not use quadratic duplicate scans on potentially atlas-scale arrays.
Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.
Do not encode V100 tile dimensions, GPU ordinals, topology routes, or runtime pointers in portable biological identity.
Do not mutate frozen CSG1, CPE2, CPK1, CSPACK, or CSH5 wire semantics without an adjacent version and compatibility route.
Do not move Cellerator mathematical semantics into CellShard or CellShard global placement/storage semantics into standalone Cellerator.
expected_inputs: The frozen shared atom/coverage/identity contracts applicable to this workstream.
Exact live source identities revalidated before implementation.
Caller-owned capacities, cost/reuse policy, and biological-stratum metadata where relevant.
expected_outputs: Focused tests and adversarial fixtures demonstrating both success and explicit rejection paths.
tasks.mechanism:
Check sorted/unique canonical entities, interval bounds, union semantics, declared counts, and content digest using scalable marks/sort/index structures.

Workstream mechanism: Validate domains, members, edge IDs, inverse maps, halos, replicas, contribution owners, residual coverage, multimodal and trajectory identity maps, partial algebras, generations, and dependency closure. Use global 64-bit identity, compact local widths, count/scan/fill or caller-owned marks, and a separate implementation from proposal builders.
data_flow_and_ownership: Cold builders may own explicit temporary storage; public execution views remain non-owning pointer-plus-count records.
Semantic identity and exact coverage are inputs or validated outputs; storage location and runtime pointers remain operational state.
Central registries, umbrella headers, package exports, and root CMake are changed only by the designated integration task.
complexity_expectations: Document asymptotic and peak-memory behavior.
Reject unbounded all-pairs or unrestricted subgraph enumeration unless this Todo is an exact small-instance oracle.
Use streaming, bounded top-L structures, sketches, sparse maps, count/scan/fill, radix/sort, or caller-owned marks as appropriate.
tasks.cold_vs_hot_path: The named mechanism is cold compilation unless explicitly described as runtime. Any steady-state path must perform no discovery, catalog parsing, hidden allocation, global sorting, or topology search.
invariants: Canonical biological identity is explicit and recoverable; shape, ordinal position, or equal extent never establishes equivalence.
Approximate evidence may propose work, but only independently certified exact coverage may enter execution.
Proposal overlap, physical-representation overlap, and execution-contribution overlap remain distinct.
Each logical contribution has one exact owner unless a versioned partial-result algebra proves reconstruction.
Structure, mutable values, transient state, runtime residency, and preference/cost freshness have separate generations and invalidation.
forbidden_shortcuts: Discovery providers may not self-certify by setting a flag.
Do not use quadratic duplicate scans on potentially atlas-scale arrays.
Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.
Do not encode V100 tile dimensions, GPU ordinals, topology routes, or runtime pointers in portable biological identity.
Do not mutate frozen CSG1, CPE2, CPK1, CSPACK, or CSH5 wire semantics without an adjacent version and compatibility route.
Do not move Cellerator mathematical semantics into CellShard or CellShard global placement/storage semantics into standalone Cellerator.
failure_cases_and_fallback: Malformed or stale identity/generation data must be rejected before execution.
Weak or unstable biological structure must produce a valid no-candidate or no-promotion outcome.
Capacity overflow, duplicate identity, incomplete coverage, and candidate explosion must return explicit diagnostics.
validation: Maintain a corruption corpus, randomized property generator, exact small-instance oracle, and streaming large-instance validation.
Add deterministic unit tests, malformed-input tests, and randomized property tests.
Where an approximate proposal is used, compare it with an exact rescan and independently validate the certified output.
Keep at least one canonical/reference fallback and differential-test against it.
performance_evidence: Record cold build time, peak memory, candidate count, and work avoided or added.
Do not promote from microkernel speed alone; report complete cost and reuse break-even.
A measured non-promotion is an acceptable terminal result for experimental mechanisms.
tasks.integration_point: Source-linked fragment or frozen interface owned by lane CS-JBC-L-CERTIFICATION; final aggregation is integration-lane-only.
tasks.parallelism: Serial within CS-JBC-L-CERTIFICATION; parallel with other provider/workstream lanes after JBC-G1-ATOM-THIN-WAIST.
tasks.completion_condition: The contract/implementation is source-complete, independently validated, profiler-visible, and consumable through fixtures without central-file edits.

tasks.title: Define the trajectory and lineage input contract

tasks.biological_motivation: Developmental and temporal workloads may reuse nearby state support, common lineage prefixes, branch-local working sets, transition operators, and compact deltas.

explicit_out_of_scope: Do not invent pseudotime or lineage from raw values.

Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.

expected_inputs: The frozen shared atom/coverage/identity contracts applicable to this workstream.

Every prefix/delta is exact after certification.
data_flow_and_ownership: Cold builders may own explicit temporary storage; public execution views remain non-owning pointer-plus-count records.
Semantic identity and exact coverage are inputs or validated outputs; storage location and runtime pointers remain operational state.
Central registries, umbrella headers, package exports, and root CMake are changed only by the designated integration task.
complexity_expectations: Document asymptotic and peak-memory behavior.
Reject unbounded all-pairs or unrestricted subgraph enumeration unless this Todo is an exact small-instance oracle.
Use streaming, bounded top-L structures, sketches, sparse maps, count/scan/fill, radix/sort, or caller-owned marks as appropriate.

Structure, mutable values, transient state, runtime residency, and preference/cost freshness have separate generations and invalidation.

Weak or unstable biological structure must produce a valid no-candidate or no-promotion outcome.
Capacity overflow, duplicate identity, incomplete coverage, and candidate explosion must return explicit diagnostics.

tasks.title: Define the shared multimodal identity spine
tasks.purpose: Define the shared multimodal identity spine. Deliver this as one isolated, reviewable step in the Multimodal identity-spine and atom discovery workstream.
tasks.biological_motivation: Paired and partially paired assays can share cells, genes, or reference coordinates while retaining distinct feature domains, values, missingness, and operation patterns.

expected_inputs: The frozen shared atom/coverage/identity contracts applicable to this workstream.
Exact live source identities revalidated before implementation.

tasks.mechanism:
Count exact repeated assembly/use across graph families, operations, datasets where valid, and runtime traces; retain confidence and strata.

Semantic identity and exact coverage are inputs or validated outputs; storage location and runtime pointers remain operational state.
Central registries, umbrella headers, package exports, and root CMake are changed only by the designated integration task.
complexity_expectations: Document asymptotic and peak-memory behavior.
Reject unbounded all-pairs or unrestricted subgraph enumeration unless this Todo is an exact small-instance oracle.
Use streaming, bounded top-L structures, sketches, sparse maps, count/scan/fill, radix/sort, or caller-owned marks as appropriate.

invariants: Canonical biological identity is explicit and recoverable; shape, ordinal position, or equal extent never establishes equivalence.

Proposal overlap, physical-representation overlap, and execution-contribution overlap remain distinct.
Each logical contribution has one exact owner unless a versioned partial-result algebra proves reconstruction.
Structure, mutable values, transient state, runtime residency, and preference/cost freshness have separate generations and invalidation.
